args:
set -eu
if [ -n "${REL_APP_PATH:-}" ]; then
  app="$REL_APP_PATH"
  if [ ! -d "$app" ]; then
    printf 'REL_APP_PATH is not an app directory: %s\n' "$app" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
elif [ -d /Applications/REL.app ]; then
  app=/Applications/REL.app
elif [ -n "${HOME:-}" ] && [ -d "$HOME/Applications/REL.app" ]; then
  app="$HOME/Applications/REL.app"
else
  app=$(/usr/bin/osascript -e 'POSIX path of (path to application id "me.rel.Rel")' 2>/dev/null) || app=
fi
if [ -z "$app" ] || [ ! -d "$app" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'REL.app was not found. Download REL from https://rel.me or set REL_APP_PATH to its app bundle.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
adapter="$app/Contents/Resources/rel-mcp"
if [ ! -x "$adapter" ]; then
  printf 'REL MCP adapter was not found or is not executable: %s\n' "$adapter" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# Check the adapter itself; bundle metadata can disagree with its executable.
version=$("$adapter" --version) || {
  printf '%s\n' 'Could not determine REL MCP adapter version. Install REL 0.1.156 or later from https://rel.me.' >&2
  exit 1
}
version=${version#rel-mcp }
if ! printf '%s\n' "$version" | /usr/bin/awk -F. '
  /^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$/ {
    if ($1 > 0 || ($1 == 0 && ($2 > 1 || ($2 == 1 && $3 >= 156)))) ok=1
  }
  END { exit !(ok && NR == 1) }
'; then
  printf 'REL 0.1.156 or later is required; adapter reports %s. Update REL from https://rel.me and restart the MCP connection.\n' "$version" >&2
  exit 1
fi
contract=$("$adapter" --api-contract 2>/dev/null) || contract=
if [ "$contract" != rel-project-sessions-v1 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'REL MCP adapter does not support the current Project/Session API. Update REL to a build with the matching adapter and restart the MCP connection.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
export REL_APP_PATH="$app"
exec "$adapter"
